snippet.title: M.B.E 3 - GAMEPLAY TRAILER 2
snippet.description:
Discord: https://discord.gg/E7sPpTMGPr

★★★★★
About the Game (EN)

You are trapped on a private property far from the city.
Your only connection to the outside world is a police operator - and even that connection is unstable.

Explore the house, garage, greenhouse, and backyard, solve simple but tense puzzles, and avoid Maniac.

A first‑person psychological horror, focused on atmosphere, sound, and constant tension rather than cheap scares.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Play now in EPISODE 2 (itch.io) - https://abyssstudio.itch.io/manckenbasementescape2
(gamejolt) - https://gamejolt.com/games/manckenbasementescape2/1032982
